title: SocialPublishingPlan 1.0.0 (social-publishing-plan-v1)
description: What a model proposes for ONE package: one channel, one format, one language, all three given by the input and never chosen here. Code checks the shape and the ids; a person edits and approves. Nothing here is posted as it is: code assembles the posted text from what a person kept. When there is nothing to say: a text the format does not use is null, a list with nothing in it is [], and a string is never empty.

angle.description: The side of the film it leads with.

message.description: The one thing a viewer should take away.

rationale.description: Why this goal, audience and angle fit the film and the channel.

hook_options.description: Different first lines to choose from. Ids H1, H2, ... in order, each once.

selected_hook_id.description: The id of the hook proposed for use. It must be an id of hook_options.

title.description: The title. null when input.limits.title.used is false. Mapped to content.title.

opening.description: The first line of the caption or description, written from the selected hook. Mapped to content.opening.

body.description: The rest of the caption or description, without the call to action, the link, the disclosure sentence and the hashtags: code adds those. Mapped to content.body.

cta.description: The call to action as one sentence, without any link. null for none. Mapped to content.cta.

hashtags.description: Without the # sign and without spaces. [] for none. Mapped to content.hashtags.

keywords.description: Search keywords or tags. [] when input.limits.keywords.used is false. Mapped to content.keywords.

claims.description: Every specific statement the copy makes about the design, the build or the film, each with the sources it rests on. [] when the copy states nothing specific. Ids C1, C2, ... each once.

artwork_options.description: Thumbnail or cover proposals, each from one asset of input.assets. [] when no asset fits. Ids A1, A2, ... each once.

layout.description: Where the subject and the text sit.

overlay_text.description: The words on the picture; null for a picture with no words.

review_notes.description: What a person must confirm, what the sources do not give, and the limits of this proposal. [] for none.
